reports.headline: Rooms Larger Than the House
reports.body: The cottage {dir} of the village {dist} is small enough to walk round in a minute. {name} stepped through its door and walked for ten before {they} reached the back wall. Inside, by that account, something kept count of every step and stood just where {they} could not quite see it.

reports.headline: A Door That Opens Onto More House
reports.body: Those who have looked through the door of the empty cottage {dir} of here {dist} describe a hall too long to fit inside it. {name} says something in there was watching the space itself, as if it were deciding where everything should go.
